rules.title: Overloaded
rules.content: DMG +1, the target is switched to the previous character, with the two characters switching places and taking 1 Piercing DMG

rules.title: Superconduct
rules.content:
Apply 1 stack of Frostbite to all opposing characters
Each stack decreases character ATK by 1 and increases Physical DMG taken by 1. (Can stack, no stack limit)
rules.contentraw: Apply <color=#FFCC33>1</color> stack of <color=#FFFFFFFF>Frostbite</color> to all opposing characters\nEach stack decreases character ATK by 1 and increases Physical DMG taken by 1. (Can stack, no stack limit)

rules.title: Electro-Charged
rules.content: Deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters
rules.contentraw: Deal <color=#FFCC33>1</color> Piercing DMG to all opposing characters

rules.title: Frozen
rules.content:
Apply 4 stacks of Frostbite to the target
Each stack decreases character ATK by 1 and increases Physical DMG taken by 1. (Can stack, no stack limit)
rules.contentraw: Apply <color=#FFCC33>4</color> stacks of <color=#FFFFFFFF>Frostbite</color> to the target\nEach stack decreases character ATK by 1 and increases Physical DMG taken by 1. (Can stack, no stack limit)

rules.title: Burning
rules.content:
Apply 1 stack of Perpetual Burn to the target
Perpetual Burn: After the character acts, they receive 1 Pyro DMG. (Can stack)
rules.contentraw: Apply <color=#FFCC33>1</color> stack of <color=#FFFFFFFF>Perpetual Burn</color> to the target\n<color=#FFFFFFFF>Perpetual Burn</color>: After the character acts, they receive 1 <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color>. (Can stack)

rules.title: Bloom
rules.content:
Create 1 stack of Dendro Core, then deal Piercing DMG worth one-third its number of stacks to a random opponent.
Dendro Core: When you deal Pyro DMG or Electro DMG to the opposing character(s), gain an enhancement.
rules.contentraw: Create <color=#FFCC33>1</color> stack of <color=#FFFFFFFF>Dendro Core</color>, then deal Piercing DMG worth one-third its number of stacks to a <color=#FFFFFFFF>random</color> opponent.\n<color=#FFFFFFFF>Dendro Core</color>: When you deal {SPRITE_PRESET#2103}<color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> or {SPRITE_PRESET#2104}<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> to the opposing character(s), gain an enhancement.

rules.title: Quicken
rules.content:
Create 2 stacks of Catalyzing Field (Max 2 stacks)
Catalyzing Field: When you deal Electro DMG or Dendro DMG to the opposing character, DMG dealt +1. (Can stack)
rules.contentraw: Create 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFFFF>Catalyzing Field</color> (Max <color=#FFCC33>2</color> stacks)\n<color=#FFFFFFFF>Catalyzing Field</color>: When you deal {SPRITE_PRESET#2104}<color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> or {SPRITE_PRESET#2107}<color=#7EC236FF>Dendro DMG</color> to the opposing character, DMG dealt +1. (Can stack)
